item.title: What to know about UMD’s winter weather resources
item.description: The university published a list of resources as temperatures remain below freezing throughout the week and classes are canceled through Friday.

item.title: ‘Millions of miles to go’: How Tom Izzo, Michigan State exposed Maryland men’s basketball
item.description: The Terps' third consecutive ranked opponent is certain to bring another challenge amid a grueling season.

item.title: UMD resident students concerned, seeking temporary accommodations after heat outage
item.description: Resident students were left without heat and hot water from Wednesday afternoon through Thursday morning after the university's Central Energy Plant lost steam service.

item.title: Maryland wrestling drops final 6 bouts in 30-9 loss to Rutgers
item.description: The Terps dropped their seventh straight match to fall to 0-6 in the Big Ten.

item.title: No. 16 Maryland women’s basketball collapses in fourth straight loss, 68-61 to Oregon
item.description: The Terps were outscored by 13 in the fourth quarter, where they shot just 25 percent.

item.title: Fans express concern as Maryland men’s basketball’s spiral continues against No. 12 Purdue, 93-63
item.description: Sunday was the Terps’ 12th loss by double digits this season and their worst in Xfinity Center history.

item.title: What to know about changes to UMD’s spring academic calendar
item.description: The university made new changes after a week of cancelled class from inclement weather.

item.title: Maryland gymnastics’ all-arounder lifts it to 196.275-195.725 win over Illinois
item.description: Terps sophomore Aine Reade competed against fellow sophomore all-arounder Chloe Cho Sunday in Champaign.

item.title: UMD opens temporary dining hall in Stamp Student Union
item.description: The makeshift dining hall will be open from 10:30 a.m. to 2 p.m. in the Colony Ballroom on Monday and Tuesday.
